title: Design guidelines for Private Wealth Management & Family Office

sections.section-content: Private Wealth Management & Family Office  is part of the SEB brand, but our clients expect a more refined experience. We always follow SEB's core design principles, including the SEB green colour and SEB Sans Serif, while making a few considered choices to create a more premium look and feel.

sections.title: Our guiding principles
sections.section-content: Everything we make should look and feel refined, with a higher level of attention to detail.

columns.title: Premium
columns.content: Does it feel considered and refined? Every detail should feel intentional, from the choice of image and words to spacing, layout and finish.

columns.title: International
columns.content: Would it feel relevant in an international context? Our communication should have a global outlook and contemporary expression, reflecting the world our clients live and operate in.

columns.title: Crisp
columns.content: Is the message immediately clear? Remove anything that does not add value. Keep the language concise and the design clean.

sections.title: Images
sections.section-content:
Our images set the tone and overall feel. They are high-quality, inspirational and often shot in international settings, reflecting an active and healthy lifestyle that resonates with our target audience. 

Compared with SEB's broader imagery, our images have a more international and lifestyle-led expression. Locations and situations are carefully chosen to feel relevant and recognisable to our clients, while remaining natural and recognisably SEB.

Combined with a strong written message, they create a solid foundation for distinctive and impactful communication.

We never use AI imagery at PWM&FO. Read more about our generative AI guidelines [here](https://seb.io/brand/generative-ai-guidelines).
